nodes.name: Architecture-Overview.md
nodes.summary: Developer wiki page describing ORGII's overall architecture: frontend layers (modules, features, scaffold, api, store, hooks) and Rust backend layers (agent session runners, agent-core, key-vault, event-store, git/advanced-search/database crates), plus a message round-trip data-flow walkthrough and key design decisions.

nodes.name: Changelog.fr.md
nodes.summary: French translation of the ORGII changelog (Journal des modifications), covering the same June/May/April 2026 release notes as the English version.

nodes.name: Changelog.md
nodes.summary: English changelog documenting monthly release notes for ORGII covering group chat coordination, WorkStation and source control, Canvas, session replay, agent runtime, authentication providers, and agent configuration from April through June 2026.

nodes.name: Changelog.zh.md
nodes.summary: Chinese translation of the ORGII changelog (更新日志), mirroring the English release notes for June, May, and April 2026.

nodes.name: Getting-Started.md
nodes.summary: Onboarding guide covering two install paths (downloading the desktop app vs. building from source), prerequisites, dev-mode setup, local build instructions, first-run provider connection, launching a first session, and a reference of useful scripts.

nodes.name: Home.fr.md
nodes.summary: French translation of the ORGII wiki home page, summarizing what the app does and linking to quick navigation, download, and license sections.

nodes.name: Home.md
nodes.summary: English landing page of the ORGII wiki summarizing what the app does, providing quick navigation links to other wiki pages, and pointing to the download and license.

nodes.name: Home.zh.md
nodes.summary: Chinese translation of the ORGII wiki home page, summarizing what the app does and linking to quick navigation, download, and license sections.

nodes.name: Sessions.md
nodes.summary: Developer wiki page explaining ORGII's session model: DispatchCategory session types, CLI agents, Rust agents, AgentExecMode execution modes, session creation/lifecycle, session list management, and Cursor IDE sessions.

nodes.name: WorkStation.md
nodes.summary: Developer wiki page documenting the WorkStation UI: panel layout (Code Editor, Chat, Terminal, Diff Viewer, Browser, Database Manager, Canvas), bottom panel, status bar, keyboard shortcuts, source control pane, and multi-session usage.

nodes.name: _Sidebar.md
nodes.summary: Wiki sidebar navigation listing links (with French/Chinese translations) to the User Guide pages (Getting Started, Sessions, WorkStation, Key Vault, Agents, FAQ, Changelog) and Developer Guide pages (Architecture Overview, Frontend Architecture, Rust Backend, Contributing).
